target_customer: Engineering teams at software companies that pay for automated pull request review, from startups to enterprises needing self-hosting
problem: Code review is a bottleneck and reviewers miss bugs because they lack context on the whole codebase.
business_model: B2B SaaS with usage credits, about 30 dollars per developer per month in reports, plus self-hosted enterprise

founders.name: Vaishant Kameswaran
education: Georgia Tech, CS with a minor in linguistics
founders.background_notes: Listed as a founder on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Indexing a repository as a graph of files and functions and reasoning over it with models for accurate bug detection was hard in 2023 to 2024 with limited context windows and false positive risk.

defensibility.rationale: Many code review startups and platform vendors offer similar features, and benchmarks are contested. Learned team rules and integrations add some lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Sacra argues platform bundling by Microsoft and others pressures pure plays. As of the searches no acquisition was reported, and the company raised a Series B in Oct 2026.

market_need_then: AI generated code increased pull request volume while review stayed manual. Greptile claims 22,000 plus teams and customers such as Nvidia and Brex on its site, unverified.

branding.name_origin: A play on grep and reptile, per a YeSpress profile of the logo; the same profile says the company was first called Onboard AI and the name came together late one night.

identity.logo: A green lizard; the 2026 refresh uses a mark meant to suggest a reptile eye, a tile for patterns and a G
identity.visual_style: Green, developer tool aesthetic with a design page and brand guidelines
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and combative, such as the Series B post titled The War on Bugs

branding.community_and_virality: Published brand design page and a blog post on the 2026 brand refresh, plus merch intent in the refresh post, per search results.

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable name and mascot that connects to developer culture, plus public brand guidelines and a refresh, in a market where developers talk about the tool. Claims of agency and in-house work on the refresh conflict.

outcome_analysis: Greptile moved from a 4 million seed in mid 2024 to a 25 million Series A led by Benchmark in September 2025 at a reported 180 million valuation, then a 50 million Series B led by Menlo at 750 million in October 2026. The surge tracks AI coding volume and a distinctive brand. Risks are bundling by GitHub and others and dependence on GitHub and GitLab.
